summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new simulated DigiLocker feature (SIH26129 / Sampark). All primary flows A–I from the review request passed: Rohan paused scholarship banner+missing INCER row+1/5 stages; DigiLocker consent screen with SIMULATED banner+tag+requester+3 docs (2 issued, INCER missing); issue-INCER toast + label change; Allow → redirect back with no code/state in URL, status becomes 'Under department review', journey 3/5, banner gone, 3 verified docs; officer sjsa sanction with masked preview dialog (holder Rohan Shah, id XXXX-XXXX, DOB XXXX-XX-11, annual income field, DIGITALLY SIGNED seal) → Completed within 5s; Aditi deny path shows application-form-error and preserves consent ticks & draft; Aditi allow path shows shared-doc-ADHAR/SSCER + grant-id + reconnect + submit → 2 verified docs + tab-consent shows 'DigiLocker (simulated)'; operator overview shows 4 connector cards incl. connector-card-digilocker + 'Benefit workflow v2', /operations/connectors shows registry-digilocker, /operations/transactions has 'awaiting documents' filter, transaction has 5 select-stage-* cards and select-stage-documents inspector shows 'digilocker-v1'; auditor can open a transaction and open a preview dialog; notifications list both 'Documents required' and 'Documents shared from DigiLocker'; mobile 390x844 shows no horizontal overflow and no text < 12px across citizen list, transaction page and DigiLocker consent page. Demo state was reset at end for jury demo.

integration_issues.flow: Auditor document preview on freshly-completed citizen transaction
integration_issues.issue: Clicking a document Preview as auditor@demo.in on Aditi's just-submitted Skill benefit transaction opens the document-preview-dialog but shows 'Document unavailable · The citizen's DigiLocker consent has expired; the document can no longer be opened.' with backend returning HTTP 410 on /api/documents/{uri}. Officer preview on the same/similar case worked. Consent should not be considered 'expired' seconds after being granted, especially for read-only auditor role. The testid contract is met (dialog opens) but the UX/behaviour is likely a bug in consent-TTL or role-based access on GET /api/documents/{uri}.

action_items: Investigate why auditor GET /api/documents/{uri} returns 410 'consent expired' immediately after Aditi grants DigiLocker consent — check consent TTL and whether auditor role bypasses the citizen-consent time window (auditors should be able to preview masked documents for the full lifetime of the transaction record).
critical_code_review_comments: Preview dialog error rendering is correct (uses the same testid contract), but the underlying /api/documents/{uri} appears to gate on citizen consent freshness; recommend distinguishing 'consent revoked' (410) from 'consent expired for citizen session' (should still allow officer/auditor if audit_reference is present).
OAuth callback (POST /api/digilocker/callback) is correctly guarded against React StrictMode double-invocation — verified no 400 duplicate-code error in console during Allow path.
URL cleanup after Allow is correct: code/state stripped from /citizen/applications/<id>.

rca of the issue: Auditor 410 on document preview: /api/documents/{uri} likely enforces citizen-consent freshness on every read, and auditor role does not have a bypass path. Fix should either (a) extend consent TTL for the lifetime of the transaction record, or (b) allow role in {officer, auditor} to fetch masked previews regardless of consent expiry as long as the transaction still exists and holds a hash reference. Reproduction: login citizen@demo.in → connect DigiLocker → allow → submit; immediately login auditor@demo.in in a fresh context → /operations/transactions → open Aditi's Skill benefit transaction → click any Preview → dialog opens with 'Document unavailable'. GET request in console returns 410.
